services.title: Services
services.intro: Images, motion and code for brands and studios. We start from a rough idea and carry it all the way to finished work, cared for in every detail.
services.note: You work directly with the people making it. One point of contact from brief to delivery.

research.label: AI / Research and production
research.title: CGI, motion and research with AI.
research.lead: We use generative models alongside 3D, animation and compositing, to try different directions and reach the right image sooner.
research.body: For every project we decide what to generate, what to model and what to finish by hand. The brief decides, together with the level of control it needs.
research.foot1: Visual explorations, concepts and sequences for campaigns.
research.foot2: Every step stays in our hands, from the first test to the final file.

code.label: Web design and development
code.body: We design and build websites, WebGL experiences and internal tools. Form, interaction and performance are worked out together.
